This is the ideal apartment to enjoy to the full a Parisian stay, and share unforgettable memories with your loved ones.The spaceThe apartment is located in a heritage building, set in a structure built under the diligent organization of Baron Haussmann.Need to store your luggage? enrichment.summary: Four bedrooms list four separate beds; a living-room sofa bed adds sleeping space. There are two WCs, two showers and a bathtub. A lift is described, but the listing notes it is small and does not establish step-free access. The dining room is listed with ten seats. One sampled guest reported a shower leak.

photoReview.bestPhotoReason: Attractive wide view of the main living area with clear dining and kitchen context.
issues: Listing says the elevator is small and suitable for one person with one suitcase at most; access through the entrance and to all rooms is otherwise unverified.

themes: Reviewers liked the central location, attractive apartment, air conditioning, and helpful staff.
concerns: One reviewer reported that a shower leaked through its door onto the bathroom floor; this is a single report.
One reviewer described the rooms as small for a group of nine; another reviewer found the overall apartment spacious.

deepReview.note: Full-size photos show a separate bed in the pictured bedroom, a fitted kitchen, a long dining table with multiple chairs, a shower enclosure, and a separate WC. The listing states ten dining seats and a small lift; the photos do not establish step-free access through the building.
